music-moods.gui.configuration.error:
Unable to save your settings.

Be sure file permissions are correctly set.
music-moods.option.separator.situational: Includes the title screen, various biomes, being underwater and battles.
music-moods.option.separator.jukebox.des: Options that tie in with jukeboxes.
music-moods.option.separator.transitions: Transitions for when a track takes over, or otherwise would abruptly stop.
music-moods.option.separator.modfest.des: Options introduced for ModFest use. Maybe you'll like them in normal gameplay too?
music-moods.option.separator.modPack.des: Options useful for mod pack creators.
music-moods.option.separator.modMenu.des:
There are options that are only available when Mod Menu is installed.

You can still manually edit those options via the config if you really must.
music-moods.option.situationalMusicRepla:
Allows replacing the current music with a more fitting track.

NEVER - Never replace the track
ALLOW - Allows replacing the track
ALWAYS - Always replace the track where applicable.
music-moods.option.alwaysPlayMusic.descr:
Whether to keep music playing at all times or not.

Good if you dislike silence.
music-moods.option.immediatelyPlayOnRepl: Plays the new situational music immediately, fading in from the old one.
music-moods.option.fadeInTicks.descripti:
How long it takes for the new track to fade in, counted in ticks.

Only applies when the old track was replaced by a new track.
music-moods.option.fadeOutTicks.descript:
How long it takes for the old track to fade out, counted in ticks.

Only applies when the old track was replaced by a new track.
music-moods.option.seamlessTransitions.d: Whether to do seamless transitions between dimensions.
music-moods.option.allowPausingMusic.des: Whether to allow music to be paused when the game is paused.
music-moods.option.jukeboxEnabled.descri: Whether Jukebox effects should apply at all.
music-moods.option.jukeboxMultiplayer.de: Whether Jukebox effects should apply in multiplayer.
music-moods.option.jukeboxReplaceRange.d:
How close you need to be for the situational music to be replaced in favor of the jukebox.

Setting this to 0 disables this.
music-moods.option.jukeboxFadeRange.desc:
How close you need to be for the situational music to be paused in favour of a jukebox.

Setting this to 0 disables this, but the replacing setting takes priority if set higher.
music-moods.option.jukeboxFadeMixTicks.d: How long it takes for the situational track to fade out when a record is played, counted in ticks.
How long it takes for the jukebox record to fade out when the record is removed, counted in ticks.
music-moods.option.rightClickToPlay.desc:
In game, right-click any disc while your inventory is open to play them.

Note: this can only be done in your player inventory.

I believe some people call this the eternal jukebox.
music-moods.option.injectUiComponents.de:
Inject buttons into Vanilla UIs for discoverability.

Note: Disabling this will hinder discoverability of Music Moods' options and should only be done if you're providing an alternative mean of accessing its settings.
